nodes.title: Rewrite role_call as React Native app
nodes.metadata_json: {"branch":"main","confidence":85,"prompt":"take the @role_call/ app and rewrite it in react native. you can keep the same db and everything. Just take it all and make it a mobile app with react native and lets see how it comes out looking. Typescript, no any() types, functional core imperative shell, good design overall. Just get it working and use SQLite too etc."}
